title: observability: token-level KV metrics, dashboards, and alert tuning for KV cost/latency
author: Priya Patel
description: Motivation: provide token-level KV cache metrics (hits/misses/evictions), cost/latency breakdowns per-model, and tuned alerts to reduce noise while preserving SLO guardrails. Changes include Prometheus metrics, Grafana dashboard panels, alert-rule adjustments, tracing span naming improvements, and docs. Summary of work: 1) Add new Prometheus collectors for kv_cache_token_hits_total / kv_cache_token_misses_total / kv_cache_evictions_total and labels (model, instance_type, deploy_env). 2) Emit token-cost and token-latency histograms tagged by model and route. 3) Add new Grafana dashboard 'KV Token-level Cost & Latency' with panels for per-model token cost, token latency percentile heatmaps, cache hit ratio, and estimated token spending. 4) Alert tuning: move kv-cache hit-rate alert to 5m window with 4% threshold (previously 1m/2%), add suppression for canary/degraded tiers, and add an SLO alert for token-cost-per-100k with a higher threshold. 5) Tracing: rename spans for kv::lookup -> kv.lookup and add attributes for cache_hit(bool) and token_count. 6) Docs: update observability/token-level-metrics.md and release notes. Checklist: - [x] Adding metrics with unit tests - [x] Dashboard JSON + panels reviewed - [x] Alert rule updates with comment blocks - [x] Docs + changelog - [x] Manual smoke test on staging Commits summary: - feat(metrics): token-level kv cache metrics and histograms - feat(dashboard): add KV token-level cost & latency dashboard - fix(alerts): tune kv cache and token-cost alerts to reduce noise - chore(tracing): normalize kv span names and attributes - docs: observability token-level metrics guide Review conversation: see review_comments field. CI: pipeline passed except intermittent observability unit test which flaked on first run and passed on rerun. Merge: squash-merged to main after approvals. Related work: ENG-4213 (KV metrics), ENG-4301 (dashboard), SUP-9021 (customer-reported noisy kv alerts). Rollout plan: staged rollout to staging -> canary -> all. Monitoring runbook updated to include new alert thresholds and suppression behavior.

release_notes: Added token-level KV cache metrics and a new Grafana dashboard for token cost/latency. Tuned alerts to reduce false positives; see docs/observability/token-level-metrics.md for rollout and cardinality guidance.
